rationale: The instrument is in extreme range compression — a $0.09 intraday range, ~1-cent 5-minute ATR, and the last five 1-minute candles pinned motionless at $21.68 on dying volume, with no headline or sector driver. The 4.6 bps spread is roughly half the entire 5-minute ATR, so any directional trade would start with the expected move largely consumed by transaction costs. With price pinned at the range top, above VWAP, and no momentum or accumulation burst to lean on in either direction, there is no mechanical edge to justify exposure.
